tree.heading: Board.—
tree.text: The term “Board” means the Surface Transportation Board.

tree.heading: Pipeline carrier.—
tree.text: The term “pipeline carrier” means a person providing pipeline transportation for compensation.

tree.heading: Rate.—
tree.text: The term “rate” means a rate or charge for transportation.

tree.heading: State.—
tree.text: The term “State” means a State of the United States and the District of Columbia.

services related to that movement, including receipt, delivery, transfer in transit, storage, handling, and interchange of property.

tree.heading: United states.—
tree.text: The term “United States” means the States of the United States and the District of Columbia.

notes.text: Prior ProvisionsProvisions similar to those in this section were contained in section 10102 of this title prior to the general amendment of this subtitle by Pub. L. 104–88, § 102(a).
Effective DateSection effective Jan. 1, 1996, except as otherwise provided in Pub. L. 104–88, see section 2 of Pub. L. 104–88, set out as a note under section 1301 of this title.
